extraction.Name: Vestal Emery
extraction.Recorded patent: recorded March 21, 1918, but records do not show by whom
extraction.Buyer: Vital Emery conveyed the land by deed to Adolph Stamer for $1.00 and other valuable consideration
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612812 issued; South half of southeast quarter section 9, north half of northeast quarter section 16, township 97, north of range 69; receipt for patent signed February 14, 1918, by the allottee; conveyance dated March 4, 1918; affidavit on record showing that Vestal and Vital Emery are one and the same person
